zh.text: SESSION 改为主服务器启动维持时间
托肯赞助卡片新增微信收款码悬停展示
控制台改为服务器日志并更换图标
PILOTS 改为服务端在线人数
首次启动默认英语，记住语言和窗口状态
移除首页账号登录并重新对齐资源监控
顶部时间改为本地时间
新增启动器内创建账号并支持是否授权 GM 权限
账号角色卡片显示真实游戏内头像
角色信息显示真实 ISK 余额
角色信息显示真实技能点 SP
角色信息显示当前舰船
角色信息显示空间站或星系位置
角色信息显示安全等级
账号与角色信息补齐多语言翻译

en.text: Removed the refresh button next to the language selector
Changed SESSION to main server uptime
Added a WeChat donation QR popover to the Token Sponsor card
Renamed Console to Server Logs and changed its icon
Changed PILOTS to server online players
First launch defaults to English and remembers language and window state
Removed the home login panel and realigned the resource monitor
Changed the top clock to local time
Added account creation in the launcher with optional GM permission
Character cards now show real in-game avatars
Character information now shows the real ISK balance
Character information now shows real skill points
Character information now shows the current ship
Character information now shows station or solar system location
Character information now shows security status
Added multilingual translations for account and character information
